clearances._sofa_note: Sofa: 1'-5 3/4" (0.45 m) legroom in front (ASSUMED). Bed mode (4'-0" deep) needs the front clear to 4'-0" from the wall - reported, not required.

doors._note: hinge = plan point; zone = quarter-disc of radius 'width' swept from the hinge into 'quadrant' (signs of dx, dy).
